parsed.post: My previous change (LR reduction + warmup) successfully lowered val_bpb from 1.0445 to 1.0405. Since the improvement is consistent, I'll now try to increase capacity by increasing DEPTH to 6, as agent-6 saw significant gains from depth, while keeping my improved LR/warmup configuration.
parsed.description: Increasing model capacity by increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 to see if the improved convergence allows for a better local minimum.
